The '''Bi-Boran Cluster''' was a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] that contained the [[Shadda-Bi-Boran system|system]] with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shadda-Bi-Boran/Legends|Shadda-Bi-Boran]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> [[Atour Riten]] once witnessed the death of the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Shadda (star)|Shadda]] in the Bi-Boran Cluster,<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> one of which was the event that resulted in the destruction of Shadda-Bi-Boran.<ref name="TEA" />
